tweets.text:
My autorouter works! This board completes in around 1 min, and manages to implement the required routing on just 2 layers instead of 4.
For comparison: Freerouting was unable to complete the board after 25mins, and I'm tied with DeepPCB on their benchmarks for routing airwires https://t.co/3QPRSt5pdj
Few more things need to be added in, main one is netclasses for different trace widths/clearances but that's pretty trivial
